records.subject: naruto
records.question: ما اسم هذا السلاح الذي يحمله أحد أعضاء أكاتسكي؟
records.comment: This is an excellent Naruto question. The image is necessary, the wording does not expose Kisame or the answer, and Samehada is recognizable without being trivial. Prefer more visual object-identification questions with this level of familiarity.

records.subject: naruto
records.question: من هو الهوكاجي الثالث في قرية الورق؟
records.comment: This represents the ideal easy-question difficulty. Hiruzen is important and familiar, but many viewers may need a brief moment to remember his name because he died early. Prefer questions whose answers are known but not immediately active in memory.

records.subject: call-of-duty
records.question: في وضع الزومبي، ما اسم الجهاز الذي يصدر هذا الصوت؟
records.comment: سؤال الصندوق الغامض جميل لكنه سهل.
